text: 도사 양반, 늦었소. 못골이 석 달째 이 꼴이오. 봉인이 흔들리오. 요사한 기운이 못골로 새고 있소. 내 눈에는 다 보이오. 오래 묵은 기운이 다시 깨어나고 있소. 내 말을 허투루 듣지 마시오. 더 늦기 전에 막아야 하오. 도사 양반, 정신 바짝 차리시오.

request.voice_description: An unmistakably elderly Korean woman around eighty, a village wise woman in a Korean historical fantasy drama. Native Korean pronunciation. A low dry croaky and grainy old female voice, rough worn throat and cracked vowels, strong age texture, clear words. Stern earthy presence, a penetrating grounded warning, controlled urgency and seasoned authority. Not sweet, young, soft counselling or cute cartoon grandmother. Firm breath support and strength, never a weak inaudible whisper. Natural acted dialogue in a clean dry studio recording.
